personality_one_liner: A stark, high-contrast, industrial command center built for maximum legibility in blinding poolside sunlight.

spacing.rule: Hard alignment, exposed structure. Use thick dividers (2pt) instead of margins to separate rows.

dont's: No glass anywhere. Use solid #FFFFFF or #000000 for sticky headers.

screens.name: LiveMeet
screens.purpose: Parents view live race progress (current + next 2) and scan QR to join.

states.empty: Illustration of pool lanes + 'Scan QR to join a meet' text + solid black CTA.

screens.layout: Header with 'JOIN MEET' QR scanner button. Below, the CURRENT RACE dominates the top half (black background, white text, red accents). Below it, a thick 2pt divider, then the next 2 upcoming races as list rows (white background, black text). Favorited events have an inverted color tag or thick border.

screens.name: QRScanner
screens.purpose: Full-screen camera for parents to scan meet QR code.
screens.layout: Camera view filling screen. Top back button. Sharp, unrounded square overlay in the center to guide scanning.

screens.name: OrganizerSetup
screens.purpose: Passcode entry and event list upload/paste.
screens.layout: Oversized typography for passcode input. Once authenticated, a huge raw text area to paste event list, and a solid black 'START MEET' button at the bottom.

screens.name: OrganizerControlPanel
screens.purpose: Organizers tap to advance the current race and display QR code for parents.
screens.layout: Top section: giant QR code for parents to scan. Middle section: Current race info in huge text. Bottom sticky CTA: Giant edge-to-edge signal red button 'ADVANCE TO NEXT RACE'. Hard mechanical interactions.

hero_poolside.alt: Swimmers poised on starting blocks before a race

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile Light personality (0 radius, 2pt borders, high contrast stark white and hard black).
Use Bebas Neue for all the large numeric data like Event and Heat numbers, make them massive (at least 3xl/48px or more) so they are readable in bright sunlight from an arm's length.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur anywhere in the app. Use solid black or stark white for overlays/sticky elements.
For the current race card, invert the colors (black background, white text) to give it maximum hierarchy. Next races should have white background, black text.
Favorited events should be highlighted with a sharp, raw UI element—like a bright Signal Red (#FF3B30) solid tag with white text saying 'FAVORITE', and a thicker 2pt border.
The Organizer Control Panel must have an unmissable, full-width, edge-to-edge sticky 'ADVANCE TO NEXT RACE' button at the bottom.
Ensure safe area is respected, but let borders run edge-to-edge horizontally to divide lists.
Implement 'color flip' (instant color inversion) on press for buttons and list items instead of standard opacity/scale animations, matching brutalist interaction patterns.
